name: Fixed Brand Navigation
job: keep agency navigation available without competing with hero
anatomy: compact fixed bar + overlay menu + primary contact action
interaction: menu opens as full overlay; page remains editorial underneath
responsive_strategy: collapse labels and retain one clear project/contact path
accessibility: trap focus in overlay; visible close; preserve contrast over media
avoid: oversized nav chrome over every section

name: Signature Media Stage
job: create one memorable spatial brand moment
anatomy: bounded canvas/video/media layer + editorial copy + explicit exit
responsive_strategy: swap complexity for one still/brand cue on narrow devices
accessibility: reduced-motion/static fallback; media must not carry sole meaning
avoid: making every section a renderer

name: Editorial Case Teaser
job: route from brand promise into named work
anatomy: large media + project identity + concise context/action
interaction: media reveal/hover supports but does not hide action
responsive_strategy: stack into readable case sequence
accessibility: link has explicit project name; hover not required
avoid: uniform generic portfolio cards

name: Code Proof Panel
job: demonstrate API ergonomics before adjectives
anatomy: truthful syntax + language context + copy/run affordance + adjacent claim
interaction: syntax/readout may animate but remains readable
responsive_strategy: replace wide code with narrower truthful sample or horizontal contained region
accessibility: keyboard-selectable/copyable where interactive; contrast for syntax tokens
avoid: decorative fake code

name: Modular Product Proof Panel
job: match each feature to the proof format it deserves
anatomy: section claim + UI/code/event artifact + short explanatory copy
responsive_strategy: use feature-specific mobile substitute rather than tiny screenshot
accessibility: controls named; states announced when dynamic
avoid: same dashboard mockup repeated for all features

name: Sticky Technical Header
job: preserve product/pricing/auth orientation
anatomy: thin sticky header + pricing/login/get-started actions
responsive_strategy: collapse nonessential links; keep auth/CTA
accessibility: focus visible against black; avoid obscuring anchors
avoid: overloaded mega-navigation

name: Cinematic World Chapter
job: advance the campaign world one authored beat at a time
anatomy: full-bleed key art/media + sparse title/copy + chapter-specific palette
responsive_strategy: swap crop/asset by aspect ratio and reduce layer count
accessibility: meaningful text remains DOM; reduced-motion still state
avoid: repeated generic feature sections

name: User-Invoked Trailer Gate
job: let expensive video act as deliberate proof
anatomy: poster/key art + obvious play action + player overlay
responsive_strategy: use responsive poster and bandwidth-aware playback
accessibility: play/pause/mute/escape; focus returns after close
avoid: long autoplay as sole product proof

name: Fixed Campaign HUD
job: provide persistent franchise/site controls without breaking cinematic flow
anatomy: minimal fixed controls + home/social/legal escape paths
responsive_strategy: reduce to compact icon/brand controls
accessibility: skip link; labelled controls; strong focus over changing art
avoid: large conventional nav bar over key art

name: Sticky Comparison Table
job: support dense multi-provider evaluation
anatomy: sticky header + aligned numeric columns + identifiers + methodology cues
interaction: sort/filter if present without moving page context
responsive_strategy: own horizontal overflow inside table or switch to record view
accessibility: headers/scopes; keyboard access; non-color state labels
avoid: shrinking columns until data is unreadable

name: Confidence/Evidence Cell
job: attach uncertainty/provenance to values
anatomy: value + freshness/confidence/source cue
interaction: tooltip/popover optional but cue remains visible
responsive_strategy: keep short cue beside value; deeper method can open separately
accessibility: not color-only; tooltip keyboard/touch accessible
avoid: hiding methodology in footer

name: Methodology Bridge
job: move users from a number to how it was measured
anatomy: inline methodology link + concise caveat near comparison/detail
responsive_strategy: keep adjacent to the decision point
accessibility: descriptive link text and visited/focus states
avoid: separate methodology island with no local links

name: Operational Pipeline Panel
job: show model/context/action causality
anatomy: stage labels + business context + agent/tool + observable output
responsive_strategy: stack stages vertically and crop UI at readable scale
accessibility: sequence must remain understandable without motion
avoid: abstract AI orb with no operational evidence

name: Integration/Workflow Card
job: show how platform connects into existing work
anatomy: integration identity + job + state/output + action
responsive_strategy: stack cards and keep identity/job visible
accessibility: logos have text labels; not logo-only meaning
avoid: logo wall without job description

name: Enterprise Plan Card
job: make package boundaries predictable
anatomy: plan name + fit + limits/outcomes + CTA
responsive_strategy: single-column comparison with preserved distinctions
accessibility: semantic list/table for comparable features
avoid: visual-only plan differentiation

name: Sticky Capability Stage
job: hold one proof surface while capability narrative changes
anatomy: sticky media/artifact panel + scrolling chapter copy
interaction: one sticky owner updates bounded states
responsive_strategy: release sticky to normal flow on narrow screens
accessibility: content order remains logical without stickiness
avoid: multiple sticky elements competing

name: Chat-to-Action Artifact
job: prove the agent changes operational state
anatomy: prompt/context + answer/source + generated artifact/action + resulting state
responsive_strategy: stack causal steps and keep source/action visible
accessibility: status changes announced; controls keyboard reachable
avoid: chat screenshot that ends before action

name: Dark Glass Pricing Card
job: separate plans without leaving the dark shell
anatomy: translucent surface + plan identity + price + feature list + CTA
responsive_strategy: stack full-width cards
accessibility: measure text/surface contrast; do not rely on translucency alone
avoid: faint glass cards with low contrast

name: Persistent Context Rail
job: orient readers through long case/editorial routes
anatomy: sticky local metadata/nav rail beside authored content
interaction: active section can update while scrolling
responsive_strategy: release rail into inline metadata on narrow screens
accessibility: landmarks and current state available to keyboard/screen reader
avoid: sticky rail occupying mobile viewport

name: Sticky Project Stage
job: give each project a distinct authored beat
anatomy: large project title/media + sticky stage + reflective evidence
responsive_strategy: decompress into stacked project blocks
accessibility: project link/action never depends on hover/drag
avoid: pinning every card regardless of reading job

name: Bounded Playground
job: express personality without infecting core tasks
anatomy: viewport-bounded objects + drag/cursor play + clear exit
responsive_strategy: disable/reframe on touch; preserve optionality
accessibility: drag cannot be required for navigation; keyboard alternative/skip
avoid: making experimental gesture the only way to reach content

name: Numbered Service Process
job: make engagement steps and outputs scannable
anatomy: 01/02/03 step + action + deliverable + transition
responsive_strategy: stack in process order
accessibility: numbers supplement descriptive headings
avoid: decorative numbers with no progression

name: Service Capability Card
job: explain what the agency does in bounded commercial units
anatomy: service title + outcome/description + supporting media/icon + CTA
responsive_strategy: stack without changing information hierarchy
accessibility: card link has service name; icon decorative if redundant
avoid: many identical rounded cards with vague copy

name: Pricing + Comparison Bridge
job: justify package choice after price is shown
anatomy: plans -> verifiable comparison/evidence -> CTA
responsive_strategy: stack plans then preserve comparison semantics
accessibility: comparison must be truthful and table/list semantics clear
avoid: vague us-vs-others superiority claims

name: Sticky Project Deck
job: turn studio work into cinematic readable stages
anatomy: full-stage project art + title + metadata + action
interaction: scroll holds one project stage at a time
responsive_strategy: keep sticky only if complete stage fits; otherwise stack
accessibility: action visible and metadata readable without motion
avoid: tiny pinned cards on mobile

name: HUD Metadata Strip
job: add game-world instrumentation without obscuring work
anatomy: mono/condensed labels + brackets/ticks + secondary facts
responsive_strategy: reduce chrome before reducing project identity
accessibility: text remains primary; avoid tiny low-contrast labels
avoid: HUD chrome becoming primary content

name: Capability-to-Case Card
job: connect what the studio sells to evidence it delivered
anatomy: capability name + concise offer + linked case/project proof
responsive_strategy: stack and keep linked proof explicit
accessibility: link purpose clear; image alt tied to project
avoid: service claim with no case evidence

name: Fixed Canvas World Layer
job: render one continuous authored world behind the story
anatomy: single fixed canvas + atmosphere + semantic foreground layers
responsive_strategy: reduce DPR/particles/FX but keep same narrative state
accessibility: canvas has DOM narrative equivalent; reduced-motion route
avoid: duplicating a renderer per chapter

name: Narrative HUD
job: expose chapter/progress/system state without becoming a dashboard
anatomy: mono chapter/time/progress controls around sparse editorial content
responsive_strategy: compress metadata and preserve only orientation-critical items
accessibility: labels and controls accessible; state not color-only
avoid: independent HUD state drifting from story

name: Opt-In Audio Gate
job: let sound deepen the story without blocking it
anatomy: explicit enter/start + sound choice + mute control
interaction: audio begins only after user intent
responsive_strategy: keep full silent path
accessibility: mute/pause keyboard accessible; content understandable without audio
avoid: autoplay soundtrack required for comprehension

name: Operational Micro-Scene
job: show short automation chains instead of abstract AI claims
anatomy: task input + state/handoff + tool/integration + output/status
responsive_strategy: replace video/canvas with still UI/text sequence
accessibility: states and actions remain understandable without animation
avoid: abstract feature icon grid

name: Integration Discovery Card
job: route from taxonomy/job to a concrete connector
anatomy: integration identity + category/job + capability + detail action
responsive_strategy: stack/search/filter while keeping category text
accessibility: logo has text name; action descriptive
avoid: logo wall as sole integration proof

name: Sticky Product Media Panel
job: hold a rich product scene while adjacent narrative changes
anatomy: sticky video/canvas/UI media + chapter copy
responsive_strategy: substitute semantic still/UI/text on mobile
accessibility: fallback content and controls; avoid motion-only meaning
avoid: keeping desktop media cost unchanged on mobile

name: Collection Flip Card
job: make projects memorable as numbered collectible entries
anatomy: creature/object + number + type + project cue + direct detail action
responsive_strategy: critical metadata always visible or tap/focus accessible
accessibility: pointer and keyboard expose equivalent information
avoid: client/work/action hidden only on hover back

name: Taxonomy Type Badge
job: make category identity repeat consistently across site
anatomy: text label + bounded accent color + emblem/creature family
responsive_strategy: keep label and accent; simplify illustration
accessibility: never color-only
avoid: freeform colors that change meaning route to route

name: Productized Quest Card
job: package playful services without hiding commercial facts
anatomy: themed title + plain outcome + price + duration + deliverables + CTA
responsive_strategy: stack as straightforward service cards
accessibility: conventional labels/CTA and readable pricing
avoid: lore-first service card with hidden scope

name: Sticky Game Selector
job: browse a small game/project set against one stable proof region
anatomy: named selectors + selected state + large art/proof panel + description/differentiators + action
interaction: desktop selector remains sticky while project proof is inspected
responsive_strategy: release sticky ownership and use normal-flow selectable project blocks on narrow screens
accessibility: use buttons/tabs with selected state, keyboard model and focus visibility; do not use roleless tabindex DIVs
avoid: pseudo-tabs with no role/state or selectors that change decoration without meaningful proof

name: Late Funnel Proof Stack
job: move visitors from confidence to objection resolution to human trust to contact
anatomy: testimonials + FAQ + team + contact details/form
interaction: accordion only where objections need expansion; other proof remains directly readable
responsive_strategy: stack in the same decision order and allow the page to grow vertically
accessibility: truthful attribution; semantic accordion; meaningful headings; labelled form fields and status feedback
avoid: template testimonials, unrelated FAQ, fake team data or reordered mobile flow that breaks causality

name: Inline Quote Form
job: convert the completed one-page story without requiring a route change
anatomy: direct contact details + name/email/subject/budget/message + clear submit action
interaction: validate fields and expose pending/success/error state
responsive_strategy: single-column fields with direct contact alternatives remaining visible
accessibility: real labels, error association, status announcement, privacy context and keyboard order
avoid: GET-to-self placeholder submission or silent success/failure

name: Pinned Sector Survey
job: let visitors survey a bounded sequence of places in one stable cinematic viewport
anatomy: chapter title + sticky viewport + horizontal sector track + place image/ID/coordinates/copy + summary/end state
interaction: vertical progress drives bounded horizontal track movement on desktop
responsive_strategy: release sticky and render the complete sector sequence vertically on narrow/reduced-motion contexts
accessibility: all place facts remain DOM/readable without scrub; no horizontal gesture required for core reading
avoid: horizontal motion with no spatial meaning or more than one competing sticky owner

name: Recovered Footage Grid
job: turn screenshots into attributable product/world evidence rather than decorative gallery filler
anatomy: asymmetric still grid + source label + scene/location + capture/build/platform metadata + proof note
interaction: mostly static; image scale provides hierarchy rather than carousel dependence
responsive_strategy: stack/crop stills while keeping provenance adjacent to the corresponding image
accessibility: meaningful alt for content images; decorative texture layers empty-alt; no motion-only meaning
avoid: invented in-engine/build/resolution claims or detached metadata

name: Telemetry Label System
job: carry compact contextual facts and world continuity across large media chapters
anatomy: coordinate/status line + chapter ordinal + sector/mission IDs + figure/build/platform/time labels
interaction: primarily readable state, not decorative animation
responsive_strategy: reduce density/spread but retain the few metadata fields that answer real contextual questions
accessibility: maintain contrast and readable font size; never encode essential state only by accent color
avoid: random pseudo-terminal strings, blinking HUD noise or unreadable tiny type

name: Mechanics Survey Row
job: give a small set of important mechanics more presence than generic cards
anatomy: top rule + compact index + oversized mechanic name + short description + optional image reveal
interaction: pointer hover may reveal media, but all semantic content remains visible at rest
responsive_strategy: stack label/name/description normally and remove pointer-specific instruction on coarse inputs
accessibility: use H2/H3/list semantics, not repeated H1; hover is enhancement only
avoid: hover-only meaning, pointer-only instructions or four interchangeable feature cards

name: Sticky Thesis Hero
job: give a service or agency thesis spatial weight before proof
anatomy: fixed nav + tall editorial thesis + supporting context + transition into narrative
interaction: desktop sticky ownership while supporting content approaches
responsive_strategy: release sticky ownership and preserve thesis/CTA in normal flow
accessibility: reading order remains DOM order; no motion-only meaning
avoid: sticky capture on small screens or sticky for decorative novelty

name: Audience-Bound Proof Module
job: show evidence that is relevant to a specific buyer context
anatomy: audience thesis + testimonial/case evidence + concise relevance framing + action
interaction: mostly direct reading; media preview optional
responsive_strategy: stack proof in the same causal order
accessibility: attribution and project identity remain readable without media playback
avoid: generic proof reused without explaining audience relevance

name: Media-Dense Proof Directory
job: scan/filter a large work corpus while retaining brand quality
anatomy: filters + project name + category/service metadata + image/video preview + case action
responsive_strategy: normal-flow project list/cards; no hover dependency
accessibility: project links named; controls semantic; playback not sole identity
avoid: dozens of autoplay videos without lifecycle control

name: Long-Form Article Outline
job: help readers navigate very long editorial pages
anatomy: article metadata + sticky section outline + long body + related content
interaction: outline follows article sections on desktop
responsive_strategy: release sticky outline into normal/compact flow on mobile
accessibility: outline links map to real headings; heading hierarchy remains primary
avoid: sticky TOC consuming narrow viewport

name: Tool Library Filter Band
job: narrow a utility library without hiding context
anatomy: fixed nav + sticky compact filter/context band + tool cards
responsive_strategy: keep band compact and horizontally safe
accessibility: semantic filter controls; current state exposed
avoid: oversized sticky controls that dominate docs

name: Install Recipe
job: move from tool promise to verified implementation
anatomy: tool identity + script + placement + attributes + staging test + demo
responsive_strategy: stack steps; wrap/pre-scroll code locally without page overflow
accessibility: copy controls named; code selectable; instructions not color-only
avoid: code snippet with no placement/configuration/verification

name: Public Styleguide Rule Block
job: turn internal implementation conventions into reusable builder guidance
anatomy: rule heading + rationale + example + sticky/contextual explanation
interaction: mostly reading; sticky example where useful
responsive_strategy: release wide sticky examples into normal flow
accessibility: examples remain understandable in text
avoid: styleguide as visual specimen without implementation rule

name: Three-Rail Documentation Reader
job: read deep API/reference docs with stable context
anatomy: fixed header + left tree + independently scrolling main article with code/parameters + right active outline
interaction: route search, anchors and copy/code actions
responsive_strategy: collapse side rails but retain independently scrolling main and keyboard focus
accessibility: landmarks, accessible anchors and keyboard scroll across nested containers
avoid: fixed rails hide content or trap focus

name: Migration Code Bridge
job: reduce switching cost from a competing provider
anatomy: competitor context + code converter + API/SDK comparison + docs/CTA
responsive_strategy: stack examples; keep code legible with contained overflow
accessibility: code/text selectable, converters labeled
avoid: generic competitor-negative claims

name: Sticky Changelog Timeline
job: scan high-volume dated releases
anatomy: sticky date marker + release card + concrete code/UI proof
responsive_strategy: date rail reflows to single column
accessibility: timestamps remain in reading order
avoid: unbounded expensive feed

name: Public Handbook Department Rail
job: show real operating principles
anatomy: oversized department index -> process article + compact department rail
responsive_strategy: large title wraps; rail collapses
accessibility: clear headings and keyboard navigation
avoid: generic values with no actionable evidence

name: Human Contribution Profile
job: attribute product/engineering work to people
anatomy: person identity + authored posts + changelog contributions
responsive_strategy: single readable contribution list
accessibility: attribution and privacy
avoid: invented achievements

name: Stack Integration Proof Block
job: show developer fit by framework
anatomy: stack headline + authentic SDK snippet + setup + CTA
interaction: framework selection and copy where available
responsive_strategy: locally scrollable code; no page overflow
accessibility: selectable truthful syntax and accessible tabs
avoid: rasterized fake code

name: Game Commerce Card
job: convert game browsing into item inspection/purchase
anatomy: illustration + category chips + game title + price + Add To Cart + detail link
responsive_strategy: cards stack in mobile shelf with readable price and action
accessibility: semantic purchase buttons and named links
avoid: art-only cards with unclear purchase action

name: Game Product Purchase + Lore Panel
job: support purchase without hiding immersion
anatomy: product media + title + price + labeled quantity + cart + long description and related items
responsive_strategy: stack media/price/action first; preserve story after purchase info
accessibility: quantity input label and keyboard operable cart controls
avoid: unlabeled generic anchor for cart

name: Game Category Landing Shelf
job: make category navigable and buyable
anatomy: category hero + matching game tiles + price/detail/cart
interaction: category links route to dedicated URLs
responsive_strategy: narrow card list without horizontal overflow
accessibility: real heading and destination links
avoid: fake tag filter disconnected from actual items

name: Game Editorial Story Continuation
job: convert community reading into more meaningful articles
anatomy: story image + category + headline + Learn More; detail with structured sections and related news
responsive_strategy: single-column story cards and legible long-form headings
accessibility: semantic article links and heading hierarchy
avoid: unverified clickbait or unrelated stories

name: Task-Oriented Workflow Proof Bento
job: show real team output, brief reuse, time savings
anatomy: task promise -> product screenshot -> specific output -> Get started action
responsive_strategy: card modules stack into long document order
accessibility: meaningful screenshot alt text and nonanimated proof
avoid: generic AI gradient without task evidence

name: Contact-First Lead Qualification Form
job: route trial/pricing interest into appropriate lead intake
anatomy: name/email + optional company + required subject/message + consent control + submit
interaction: form validation and observable completion response
responsive_strategy: one-column fields remain readable on 390px
accessibility: associated labels, required statuses, consent separate
avoid: free-trial CTA without explanation that contact is first

name: Branded Email and OTP Panels
job: maintain brand context across separate email/code/profile pages
anatomy: shared header/footer + email entry + OTP form + account name/email
interaction: email -> verification code -> account continuation (backend untested)
responsive_strategy: form shrinks to one column and preserves recovery links
accessibility: type=email and OTP autocomplete, status/error announcements and keyboard buttons
avoid: assuming a visible account form proves secure identity

name: SaaS Pricing Cards with Billing State
job: help choose Starter/Pro/Teams and billing units
anatomy: three feature lists + price/unit + popular tag + monthly/yearly selection + lead action
interaction: selection must change price and accessible selected state when real
responsive_strategy: three cards stack while preserving billing information
accessibility: semantic switch/radio, unit clarity and accessible changes
avoid: static switch claiming 20% discount without price update
